name: Gin Rummy
tagline: Build sets and runs, cut your deadwood, and knock before your opponent does.
rulesSummary: Each turn, draw from the stock or take the top discard, then discard one card.
Melds are sets (3–4 of a rank) or runs (3+ in a suit, ace low). Everything else is deadwood (faces 10, ace 1).
Knock when your deadwood is 10 or less. Your opponent lays off what they can on your melds.
Lower deadwood scores the difference. Undercut the knocker for +25; gin (no deadwood) is +25.
Your melds are arranged for you automatically — the hint shows your deadwood.
